verdict.rationale: Setting up autonomous background automations is a fair question for an AI inference platform, but the evidence shows no such product capability: no scheduled jobs, triggers, or background agent runtime. The related items don't qualify. Asynchronous batch inference is an adjacent feature, the REST API for automating model and deployment management is a developer building block, and Auto Reload is a billing control. Internal GPU scheduling for fine-tuning is not a user-configured automation.
